decision: Announced identity-only successor for P36 safe CPU affinity sets. The jope-campaigns nix sched dependency adds the safe CpuSet API and changes Cargo.lock. This transition also closes the unrecorded evaluator identity drift introduced by #1659, which was already red on origin/main. Evaluator calculations, DSL ABI, behavior fixtures, and historical identity rows are unchanged. Upstream #1718 changed engine sources recorded by the lineage fixture; this rebaseline records those source hashes alongside generated_at_sha. No known-identity row is added without a shipped receipt.
plan_reference: P36 rust-bad-behavior cap; ADR-0004 and compat_freeze identity-only procedure
